crossRefs.note: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there…
They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Gerasa
people.line: Region where Jesus healed a demon-possessed man

translations.web: They arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.
translations.bsb: Then they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee.
translations.kjv: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
translations.asv: And they arrived at the country of the Gerasenes, which is over against Galilee.
